playbooks.title: Insufficient funds soft recovery
playbooks.guidance: Soft decline. Prefer a delayed retry near salary/credit cycles (24-48h). Avoid aggressive same-day retries. If second failure, send polite dunning with update-payment CTA.

playbooks.title: Issuer/network transient failure
playbooks.guidance: Transient infrastructure decline. Retry quickly (15-120 minutes). Do not message the customer on first transient failure.

playbooks.title: Soft bank decline
playbooks.guidance: Issuer soft decline. Retry once after 8-24h. If amount is high and p_recovery is moderate, escalate for manual review.

playbooks.title: Customer authentication required
playbooks.guidance: Customer action needed (3DS/OTP/mandate). Send dunning with secure payment-update link. Silent retry alone often fails.

playbooks.title: Frequency limit hit
playbooks.guidance: Too many attempts in a window. Back off at least 24h. Cap retries to avoid issuer blacklisting.

playbooks.title: Hard decline — do not retry
playbooks.guidance: Hard decline or fraud signal. Never auto-retry. Ask customer to update payment method through a secure flow only if policy allows.

playbooks.title: Default soft-decline playbook
playbooks.guidance: Unknown soft decline. Conservative single retry with monitoring. Prefer human escalation for high ticket amounts.
